info.title: InfraX Hub MCP API
info.description: InfraX Hub MCP — unified market-data / ML / RAG knowledge-graph API (13 tools aggregated from data :9112, injector :9113, ragservicer :9721). Call tools via MCP Streamable HTTP (POST /mcp/message, JSON-RPC: methods/tools-call).

post.summary: MCP Streamable HTTP message (JSON-RPC 2.0): tools/list, tools/call, resources/read, prompts/get
post.description: Body: {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"<tool>","arguments":{...}}}. Supported tools (13) are listed under x-mcp-tools with their input schemas.

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: InfraX API key (Authorization: Bearer also accepted)

x-mcp-tools.name: data_bars
x-mcp-tools.description: Query OHLCV kline bars from the InfraX market data service. Supports stocks, forex, crypto (spot/swap) and A-share symbols.

symbol.description: Trading symbol, e.g. BTC/USDT, BTCUSDT, AAPL, EURUSD, 600519, GC=F

x-mcp-tools.name: data_ticker
x-mcp-tools.description: Get the latest market ticker (price) for a symbol from the InfraX market data service.

symbol.description: Trading symbol, e.g. BTC/USDT, AAPL, EURUSD

x-mcp-tools.name: data_factors
x-mcp-tools.description: Query technical / macro / on-chain factors for a symbol (current values).

factor.description: Specific factor id (see /factors/catalog), e.g. us10y, rsi14; omit for all

x-mcp-tools.name: data_factors_history
x-mcp-tools.description: Query historical factor series for a symbol over a time window.

x-mcp-tools.name: data_snapshots
x-mcp-tools.description: Query snapshot data (macro, crypto, onchain, defi, indices...) by type.

type.description: Snapshot type, e.g. onchain (BTC sub-types), macro, indices, defi_tvl

x-mcp-tools.name: data_symbols
x-mcp-tools.description: List or search supported trading symbols in the InfraX market data service.

query.description: Search keyword, e.g. BTC or 600519; omit to list all

market.description: Market: crypto (default), usstock, forex, futures, cnstock, hkstock

x-mcp-tools.name: ml_predictions
x-mcp-tools.description: Get model predictions for a symbol from the InfraX ML pipeline (tree / direction models).

x-mcp-tools.name: data_symbol_search
x-mcp-tools.description: Fuzzy-search supported symbols across markets (crypto / usstock / forex / futures / cnstock / hkstock).

keyword.description: Fuzzy keyword, e.g. btc, eth, apple, 600519

market.description: Market: crypto (default), usstock, forex, futures, cnstock, hkstock

x-mcp-tools.name: data_symbol_resolve
x-mcp-tools.description: Resolve a raw symbol keyword to the canonical trading symbol (e.g. BTC -> BTCUSDT).

symbol.description: Symbol keyword, e.g. BTC, BTC/USDT, EURUSD=X, apple

market.description: Market: crypto (default), usstock, forex, futures, cnstock, hkstock

x-mcp-tools.name: data_broker_policy
x-mcp-tools.description: Get the broker market policy (which exchanges are the primary trading venue per market).

x-mcp-tools.name: data_stats
x-mcp-tools.description: Get InfraX data service database stats (kline rows, snapshot rows, symbol count, coverage range).

x-mcp-tools.name: injector_trigger
x-mcp-tools.description: Trigger a manual data injection into the knowledge graph (fetches + embeds a data source). Write op: runs background ingestion.

source.description: Injector source, e.g. macro, sentiment, crypto_overview, onchain, defi_tvl, news_sentiment

x-mcp-tools.name: rag_query
x-mcp-tools.description: Query the InfraX RAG knowledge base (vector + graph + keyword hybrid search). Returns relevant context from indexed documents.

namespace.description: Namespace/collection to query, e.g. market, onchain
